title: Shree Cement
extract: Shree Cement is an Indian cement manufacturer, founded in Beawar, Rajasthan, in 1979. Headquartered in Kolkata, it is India's third largest cement producer group by capacity and third largest cement company by market capitalisation. Shree Cement has an installed cement production capacity of 66.8 mtpa including overseas operations. It also produces and sells power under the name Shree Power (captive power plant) and Shree Mega Power.
